ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for extraction all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject only to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause: on termination we need up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of our Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion afterwards. The current Section 10 covers access wind-down and Deliverables but says nothing about getting our data back or migration help; if six months is difficult we can work with 90 days of assistance.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return within 30 days, and certified deletion.
